F6 · 认证 Skill 的路由示例无法通过类型检查

文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/app-server · 原评审：未解决

⌄

两条 Skill 指引互相矛盾：认证 Skill 展示“直接返回 typed Hono”，服务端路由参考展示“typed 子路由必须再包一层”。Agent 更可能先读到前者，从而在三处路由重复犯错。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

protecting-routes.md 的示例声明 `AppApiRouteContribution<Application>`，在 defineApiRoutes 回调里直接从 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()` 返回类型化子路由，读者会认为这是可用模式。

评审时 · 实际观察

defineApiRoutes 的工厂类型是 `AppRouterFactory`，返回未参数化的 `Hono`；工程按该示例实现后 tsc 报 TS2345。同一仓库的 app-development `server-routes.md` 给出的外层普通 Hono + `router.route()` 挂载写法才是类型正确的。

实际影响
制作成本增加与错误定位困难：错误信息落在 Hono 泛型内部，非框架作者不易判断是自身写法还是示例问题。
建议改法
把 protecting-routes.md 示例改为外层 `new Hono()`、内层 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()` 并用 `router.route()` 挂载，或先修好框架类型后统一示例。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
按认证 Skill 的路由示例，在 defineApiRoutes 回调中直接返回 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()`。
应有能力 / 行为
示例可原样编译，并展示 auth.required 与受保护子路由的正确装配。
实际观察
tsc 报 TS2345（Hono<AuthEnv> 不能赋给 AppRouterFactory 的 Hono<BlankEnv>），需额外外包一层普通 Hono 才能通过。
应用绕行与代价
放弃示例写法，改用 app-development `server-routes.md` 的外层普通 Hono + `router.route()` 挂载。
改进后的验收标准
同一示例在仓库内通过全量 tsc，且与 server-routes.md 的写法不再矛盾。

export const apiRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> = defineApiRoutes(
  (app) => {
    const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
    const routes = new Hono<AuthEnv>();

    routes.use('/orders/*', auth.required());
    routes.get('/orders', (context) => {
      const { user, session } = context.get('auth')!;
      return context.json({ userId: user.id, expiresAt: session.expiresAt });
    });

    return routes;
  },
);

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md:55–85E69

app-development 服务端路由参考：外层 new Hono()，内层 new Hono<AuthorizationEnv>() 用 router.route 挂载到子路径——这是类型正确的 documented 组合。

```ts
import {
  authorizationToken,
  type AuthorizationEnv,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization';

export const orderAdminRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> =
  defineApiRoutes((app) => {
    const router = new Hono();
    const routes = new Hono<AuthorizationEnv>();
    const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
    const authorization = app.container.resolve(authorizationToken);

    routes.use('*', auth.required(), authorization.middleware());
    routes.get('/', async (context) => {
      const allowed = await context.get('authz').can({
        resource: { type: 'settings', id: 'orders-admin' },
        action: 'read',
      });
      if (!allowed) {
        return context.json({ error: 'Not allowed.' }, 403);
      }

      return context.json({ data: await listOrders() });
    });

    router.route('/orders-admin', routes);
    return router;
  });
```

### [重要][指引错误] 认证 Skill 的路由示例无法通过类型检查

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-server`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.29）

两条 Skill 指引互相矛盾：认证 Skill 展示“直接返回 typed Hono”，服务端路由参考展示“typed 子路由必须再包一层”。Agent 更可能先读到前者，从而在三处路由重复犯错。

**文档 / API 声称**：protecting-routes.md 的示例声明 `AppApiRouteContribution<Application>`，在 defineApiRoutes 回调里直接从 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()` 返回类型化子路由，读者会认为这是可用模式。

**实际观察**：defineApiRoutes 的工厂类型是 `AppRouterFactory`，返回未参数化的 `Hono`；工程按该示例实现后 tsc 报 TS2345。同一仓库的 app-development `server-routes.md` 给出的外层普通 Hono + `router.route()` 挂载写法才是类型正确的。

**影响**：制作成本增加与错误定位困难：错误信息落在 Hono 泛型内部，非框架作者不易判断是自身写法还是示例问题。

**建议改动**：把 protecting-routes.md 示例改为外层 `new Hono()`、内层 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()` 并用 `router.route()` 挂载，或先修好框架类型后统一示例。

**验收标准**：同一示例在仓库内通过全量 tsc，且与 server-routes.md 的写法不再矛盾。

F2 · AppRouterFactory 返回未参数化 Hono，类型化环境无法在贡献边界声明

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/app-server · 原评审：未解决

⌄

`AppRouterFactory<TApplication>` 的返回类型是 `Hono | Promise<Hono>`，即 BlankEnv；使用 `Hono<AuthEnv>` 的处理器不能直接作为工厂返回值，必须再包一层普通 Hono。repair-1 因此在 attachments.ts、material-content.ts、materials.ts 三处命中 TS2345。

实际影响
每个需要读取 context.get('auth') 的应用贡献都要写同样的包装样板，且错误信息指向 Hono 内部 handler 逆变，定位成本高。
建议改法
把工厂返回类型放宽为 `Hono<any> | Promise<Hono<any>>` 或引入环境泛型参数，使贡献可声明自己的 Hono env。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
在 defineApiRoutes 中直接返回 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()`。
应有能力 / 行为
类型化子路由可作为路由贡献工厂的返回值。
实际观察
TS2345：Hono<AuthEnv> 不能赋给 Hono<BlankEnv>，需外层再包一个普通 Hono。
应用绕行与代价
外层 `new Hono()`，内层 `new Hono<AuthEnv>()` 用 `router.route()` 挂载。
改进后的验收标准
一个 usage（无 type assertion、无包装样板）通过全量 tsc，且 context.get('auth') 仍具类型。

app/server/routes/attachments.ts:44–86E74

应用装配：owner scope + create defaults 的 RepositoryPolicy，`actions:{uploadOne:{maxSize}}`，仅在 `materialAttachments:uploadOne` 上挂 auth.required()，把带类型子路由挂进普通 Hono。

/** Every row this principal may read or produce belongs to them, and every upload is stamped with their id. */
const policy = (principal: Principal): RepositoryPolicy => ({
  read: { scope: { ownerId: principal.id }, fields: [...FILE_COLUMNS] },
  create: {
    scope: { ownerId: principal.id },
    defaults: { ownerId: principal.id },
  },
  update: false,
  delete: false,
});

const [pluginApiRoute] = defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes<Principal>({
  principal: (context) => {
    const session = (context as Context<AuthEnv>).get('auth');
    return session ? { id: session.user.id } : null!;
  },
  repositories: [
    {
      name: NAME,
      collection: NAME,
      disk: 'local',
      accessPath: ACCESS_PATH,
      policy,
      actions: { uploadOne: { maxSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 } },
    },
  ],
});

export default defineApiRoutes(async (app: Application) => {
  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
  const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);

  // Scoped to the exact action path this application exposes: no wildcard, so nothing the plugin may add later is
  // authenticated by accident, and no other contribution's path is affected.
  router.use(`/${NAME}:uploadOne`, auth.required());
  router.route('/', await pluginApiRoute.createRouter(app));

  // `defineApiRoutes` returns a plain `Hono`; the typed router is mounted into one so the
  // handlers keep their `AuthEnv` context (`context.get('auth')`) without widening it away.
  const root = new Hono();
  root.route('/', router);
  return root;
});

### [轻微][能力缺口] AppRouterFactory 返回未参数化 Hono，类型化环境无法在贡献边界声明

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-server`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.29）

`AppRouterFactory<TApplication>` 的返回类型是 `Hono | Promise<Hono>`，即 BlankEnv；使用 `Hono<AuthEnv>` 的处理器不能直接作为工厂返回值，必须再包一层普通 Hono。repair-1 因此在 attachments.ts、material-content.ts、materials.ts 三处命中 TS2345。

**影响**：每个需要读取 context.get('auth') 的应用贡献都要写同样的包装样板，且错误信息指向 Hono 内部 handler 逆变，定位成本高。

**建议改动**：把工厂返回类型放宽为 `Hono<any> | Promise<Hono<any>>` 或引入环境泛型参数，使贡献可声明自己的 Hono env。

**验收标准**：一个 usage（无 type assertion、无包装样板）通过全量 tsc，且 context.get('auth') 仍具类型。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-server/dist/router/routes.d.ts:1–2` — `AppRouterFactory<TApplication> = (app) => Hono | Promise<Hono>`：返回类型是未参数化的 Hono（BlankEnv），未暴露环境类型参数。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md:55–85` — app-development 服务端路由参考：外层 new Hono()，内层 new Hono<AuthorizationEnv>() 用 router.route 挂载到子路径——这是类型正确的 documented 组合。
- `artifacts/verify-2.log:15–24` — repair-1 后全量 typecheck 失败（exit 2）：materials.ts(217,26) TS2769（string[] 作为 filter）、attachments.ts(68,7) TS2353（uploadOne 位置）、attachments.ts(73,32) TS2345（Hono<AuthEnv> 返回不匹配 AppRouterFactory）。
- `app/server/routes/attachments.ts:44–86` — 应用装配：owner scope + create defaults 的 RepositoryPolicy，`actions:{uploadOne:{maxSize}}`，仅在 `materialAttachments:uploadOne` 上挂 auth.required()，把带类型子路由挂进普通 Hono。

> 来源：nb3-factory 独立搭建评审（口径 v2，源 Run 36641597342 / attempt 1）。尚未复核最新上游源码。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:238–248E71

db Skill：filter/values/select/sort 接受 builder 回调或等价 JSON AST，明确不接受简写字符串数组；Repository 自身不应用权限，需在进入 filter 前决定可见性。

`filter`, `values`, `select` and `sort` each accept a builder callback or the equivalent serializable JSON AST, and mean the same thing either way. They do not accept a shorthand string array such as `['id', 'name']` or `['-createdAt']`. Field names are Collection logical names, never column names. A write returns a result object — the record is `result.record`, alongside `result.version` and the created relation targets — rather than the record itself. `findMany` is awaited for an array or iterated asynchronously to consume a large result incrementally.

The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
app/server/providers/materials.ts:208–238E77

应用使用 FilterBuilder 组合：`filter.and([string().eq, or([...])])` 校验附件归属与存在性。

  /** An attachment the caller may link: it exists, belongs to them, and is one of the accepted types. */
  private async resolveAttachmentIds(
    ownerId: string,
    attachmentIds: readonly string[],
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    const unique = [...new Set(attachmentIds.filter(Boolean))];
    if (!unique.length) return [];

    const found = await this.attachments.findMany({
      filter: (filter) =>
        filter.and([
          filter.string('ownerId').eq(ownerId),
          filter.or(unique.map((id) => filter.string('id').eq(id))),
        ]),
    });
    if (found.length !== unique.length) {
      throw new MaterialsError(
        'ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND',
        'One of the selected attachments is missing or belongs to someone else.',
      );
    }
    for (const attachment of found) {
      if (!MATERIAL_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.includes(attachment.ext)) {
        throw new MaterialsError(
          'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED',
          `Only ${MATERIAL_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.join(', ')} attachments are allowed.`,
        );
      }
    }
    return unique;
  }

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Repair-2 修复了两类真实失败：一是实现阶段只交付了服务端 materials/materialAttachments 代码，没有客户端资料页面、路由、导航、文案与示例数据，浏览器验收 B01–B06 全部无法执行；二是 repair-1 为补页面修改服务端时引入了 typecheck 错误。本轮补齐 /materials 页面（列表/新建/编辑/详情/删除、上传状态、预览下载、损坏图片说明）、双语 key 与 2 份样例资料，并修正 Repository 过滤、File 暴露配置与 Hono 路由类型，最后用集成测试验证了甲/乙/匿名对附件字节的隔离。

问题 01 · 实现阶段

应用只有资料服务端接口，没有任何资料业务界面

本任务已处理

浏览器验收 B01–B06 全部失败：主应用导航只有 Home；首页是模板空状态；/main/materials 回退到首页；页面内搜索不到资料/附件/上传/文档预览等任何控件；materials:list 与 attachments:create 返回前端 HTML 或 404。

原因（实现者自述）
实现阶段只创建了 database/main/migrations 的 materials 表、server/providers/materials.ts、server/routes/* 与附件上传/字节路由，没有 client/routes.ts 路由、client/pages 页面、导航项、客户端 locale key，也没有示例数据 seed；服务端 API 存在但没有任何界面驱动它。
处理方式
新增 client/routes.ts 的 /materials（auth: required、authz: 'skip'、navigation），新增 client/pages/materials/*（列表、新建/编辑表单、详情、删除确认，复用 FileUploadField 上传、FilePreviewDialog 预览、自定义下载），在 client/locales/en-US.ts 与 zh-CN.ts 补齐全部文案，并新增 database/main/seeds/202609300001_create_material_samples.ts 写入 2 份样例资料。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 修复阶段

repair-1 修改服务端时引入 typecheck 错误，流水线卡在 typecheck

本任务已处理

verify-2 typecheck 退出码 2：server/providers/materials.ts(217) TS2769（string[] 不能赋给 FilterShorthandValue）；server/routes/attachments.ts(68) TS2353（uploadOne 不在 FileRepositoryApiExposure 上）；attachments.ts(73)、material-content.ts(32)、materials.ts(26) TS2345（Hono<AuthEnv> 不能赋给 AppRouterFactory 的 Hono<BlankEnv>）。

原因（实现者自述）
三处对公共 API 的用法与类型不符：Repository.findMany 不支持把 id 数组直接当 filter 值（需要 FilterBuilder）；File 暴露的 uploadOne 配置属于 actions 字段而非暴露根对象；defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes 的工厂签名要求返回未参数化变量的 Hono，直接返回 Hono<AuthEnv> 时 Variables 不匹配。
处理方式
materials.ts 改用 filter 回调 filter.and([ownerId 等值, filter.or(ids)])；attachments.ts 把 maxSize 移入 actions.uploadOne；三处路由改为先构造空白 Hono，再 root.route('/', 类型化 router) 后返回。tsc --noEmit、tsconfig.server.json、tsconfig.node.json 三类检查均已通过。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 自动验证

cookie 写入被 CSRF 校验拒绝：INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN

本任务已处理

集成测试中带 session cookie 的 POST/PATCH/DELETE 返回 403 {"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"}，即使已登录。

原因（实现者自述）
app-plugin-authentication 的 Auth.checkCookieWriteOrigin 要求 cookie 写入请求带有可信 Origin，其 baseURL 取 app.publicOrigin；内嵌测试未设置 APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN，请求也未带 Origin 头。
处理方式
集成测试 createInstalledStandaloneServer 传入 env APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN 并在写请求上带 origin 头；工厂 browser-acceptance.sh 本身已在 pnpm start 前导出 APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN，因此真实浏览器验收不受影响。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 自动验证

better-auth 拒绝带连字符的 username：Username is invalid

本任务已处理

集成测试注册乙账号时 POST /api/auth/sign-up/email 返回 400，stderr 为 [Better Auth]: Username is invalid。

原因（实现者自述）
better-auth username 插件默认 usernameValidator 为 /^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$/，不接受连字符；测试用 materials-<unique> 作为用户名。
处理方式
测试改用纯数字/字母用户名 materials<unique>。工厂自身生成的 FACTORY_TEST_USERNAME 已用 ${credential_suffix//-/} 去掉连字符，因此应用与工厂无需改动。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 自动验证

集成测试 URL 拼接错误导致隔离断言假通过

本任务已处理

首次断言乙 GET 甲的附件字节时得到 200 而非 404，看起来像越权。

原因（实现者自述）
服务端返回的 contentUrl 已包含 publicBasePath（如 /main/uploads/...），测试又用 baseUrl（也含 publicBasePath）做前缀，请求 /main/main/uploads/... 落到前端 HTML 回退，返回 200。
处理方式
改为直接请求 http://localhost${contentUrl}；修正后匿名 401、乙 404、甲 200 且 content-type 为 image/png、content-disposition 为 attachment，证明内容访问边界生效。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · 修复阶段

ESLint react-hooks/set-state-in-effect 拒绝在 effect 内同步 setState

本任务已处理

lint（--max-warnings 0）报错：Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders，位置 client/pages/materials/index.tsx 的 void load()。

原因（实现者自述）
列表加载写成 useCallback + 在 effect 体内同步调用 setState 的函数；新的 react-hooks/set-state-in-effect 规则不允许。
处理方式
改为在 effect 内直接发起 promise，并用 active 标志与 reloadToken 管理刷新：listMaterials(api).then(...).catch(...)，重试按钮递增 reloadToken。lint 与 typecheck 均通过。

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · Skill 与文档

服务端路由与 Repository 过滤的类型用法缺少示例

可自动化

本轮三处 typecheck 错误都来自公共 API 的约定：defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes 的工厂必须返回未参数化变量的 Hono（直接返回 Hono<AuthEnv> 会因 Variables 不匹配而 TS2345）；Repository.findMany 不支持 id 数组，需要用 FilterBuilder 的 filter.or 构造；File 暴露的 uploadOne/maxSize 属于 actions 字段。

建议改动

在 nocobase-app-development 的 server-routes 与 database-and-data 参考中各补一段最小示例：演示空白 Hono 包装类型化 router 的写法、FilterBuilder 的 or/in 写法，以及 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 的 actions 结构；并补一条从任一参考都能命中的类型错误速查。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · Skill 与文档

File 插件默认内容路由是公开的，私有业务需自行提供字节路由

可自动化

defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 返回 [apiRoutes, rootRoutes]，第二个是 /uploads/<name>/:file 的公开字节路由，只按 UUID 查记录、不校验调用者；应用若为私有资料，必须只挂载第一个，并按 ownerId 自行实现鉴权字节路由（本轮做法），否则任何人拿到链接即可读取。

建议改动

在 app-plugin-file Skill 的私有/公开边界一节明确写出：默认 root 内容路由不经过 Repository Policy，私有业务不得挂载它，并给出返回数组的拆解与 ownerId 过滤的最小实现示例。

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · 验收机制

附件内容隔离的断言应校验内容类型，避免 SPA 回退造成假通过

可自动化

仅断言 HTTP 200/404 时，路径写错会落到前端 HTML 回退并返回 200，看起来像越权或像成功。本轮正是这样先得到一次假阳性。

建议改动

生成的内容访问集成测试除状态码外，至少断言响应 content-type 与 Content-Disposition，或在请求未知/越权路径时显式断言响应不是 text/html。

来源：Agent · retro.json

Do\nnot use it to modify the Users plugin source or to replace Authentication's\nuser, account, or Session storage.\n\n## Public surfaces\n\n- Client registration factory and `UsersClientOptions`:\n  `@nocobase/app-plugin-users/client`.\n- Typed API client: `UsersClient` and its types from\n  `@nocobase/app-plugin-users/client/user-client`.\n- Server contracts: `userManagementServiceToken`,\n  `userRoleScopeRegistryToken`, `UserRoleScope`, and related types from\n  `@nocobase/app-plugin-users/server/tokens`.\n- HTTP API: `/api/users`, `/api/users/options`, and the user-specific update,\n  enable, disable, role-scope, password-reset, and Session-revocation routes.\n\nEvery HTTP route requires Authentication and Authorization. Routes check the `user` record type with one of `read`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `assign-role`, `reset-password`, `revoke-sessions` or `delete`. Account creation checks both `create` and `assign-role`. `delete` is permitted only while an application role scope can clean a deleted user up.\n\n## Register and place the page\n\n1. Register Authentication, Authorization, and then Users in the App's Client\n   and Server plugin arrays.\n2. Configure the Client factory. `users({ mount: 'settings', path: '/users' })`\n   produces `/settings/users`; `mount: 'app'` makes the path App-relative and\n   registers a primary-navigation entry protected by the same page access rule.\n3. Grant the page, `{ resource: { type: 'page', id: 'users' }, actions: [{ action: 'access' }] }` or `authz.pages.grant('users')`, to roles that may open it.\n4. Grant only the `user` actions those roles need, on `{ type: 'user', id: '*' }` because `user` is a record type. The plugin creates no roles and grants no access by itself.\n5. Use `componentLoader` only to replace the page implementation. It does not\n   change the route identity, mount, or path.\n\nThe page reports results through `useToaster()` from `@nocobase/app-client`, so the App needs the `@nocobase/app-client` that exports it and registers a toaster service, as the templates do: `client/lib/toaster.ts` from the template, and `this.app.container.instance(toasterToken, createToaster())` in the `register()` of `client/service-provider.ts`, with the `Toaster` component mounted in `client/react-providers.ts`. Without the registration nothing throws, but its toasts are only logged to the browser console. Update `@nocobase/app-client` together with this plugin; the `nocobase-app-upgrade` Skill's `references/edge-cases.md` (\"Notifications and the application toaster\") has the full steps.\n\nThe default `app` permission-set scope is supplied by Users whenever the Authorization plugin's `authorizationToken` is available. Do not copy a user-roles Provider into an application. Set `users.permissionSets: false` to replace the default with an application-owned scope; Hub uses this setting.\n\n## Add an application role scope\n\nResolve `userRoleScopeRegistryToken` in an application or business plugin\nServiceProvider and register one `UserRoleScope` during `boot()`. The scope owns\nits available options, current assignment lookup, role filtering, atomic\nreplacement, and any disable guard. Unregister it during `shutdown()`.\n\nUse the `DatabaseConnection` passed to each scope method. This is the\ncaller-owned transaction used to keep account creation or state changes atomic\nwith role assignments. Do not open an unrelated transaction and do not write\nAuthentication's internal tables.\n\nFor a required single-role scope, set `selection: 'single'` and\n`requiredOnCreate: true`. Reject invalid values in the scope and enforce\nbusiness invariants such as the last-administrator rule on the server.\n\nSet `assignable: false` or `removable: false` on an option when the Users page\nmust show a protected assignment but must not add or revoke it. Enforce the\nsame rule in `replace()` because these flags only control the Client. Set\n`hasAuthenticatedDefaultAccess: true` when the scope lists direct assignments\nbut all signed-in users also inherit separately configured default access; the\npage then explains that distinction instead of treating the default as a role.\nUse `labelI18nKey` with `labelI18nNs` on a scope or option when its owner has\nregistered Client locale resources; keep `label` as the readable fallback.\nImplement optional `getMany()` when assignments can be read as a batch. Users\nuses it for list pages and falls back to `get()` for existing scopes.\n\n## Ownership\n\n- Authentication owns user identity, credentials, account state, password\n  hashing, and Sessions.\n- Authorization owns Permission Sets, grants, and assignments.\n- Users owns the management API, built-in page, orchestration transaction,\n  `user` authorization handler, and role-scope registry.\n- The App or business plugin owns role definitions, role grants, assignments,\n  page placement, and role-specific invariants.\n- The plugin's `skills/` source is authoritative. `.agents/skills/` is a\n  synchronized copy and must not be edited.\n\n## Permissions and constraints\n\n- Browser route access is only navigation control. The Server independently\n  authenticates and authorizes every request.\n- An App-mounted page hides its primary-navigation entry until `access` on page `users` is allowed. Direct navigation is checked separately by the Client Route.\n- A conditional grant is not accepted as an unrestricted user-management\n  grant; use explicit static grants for this resource.\n- The plugin does not provide user deletion or invitations.\n- Disabled users are rejected by Authentication and lose their existing HTTP\n  Sessions and Realtime connections.\n- Password hashes, Session tokens, reset tokens, and submitted passwords are\n  never returned by the service or included in security events.\n\n## Verification\n\n- A role without `access` on page `users` cannot navigate to the page.\n- Anonymous API requests return `401`; authenticated requests without the\n  requested `user` action return `403`.\n- Creating a user with a required role scope creates both records, while role\n  assignment failure rolls back the user.\n- Duplicate emails or usernames return a stable `409` conflict. Password reset\n  and database Session revocation commit or roll back together.\n- Disabling a user invalidates HTTP Sessions and Realtime connections; enabling\n  the user requires a new login.\n- Role changes become visible after transaction commit and do not alter\n  assignments outside the registered scope.\n- The target App passes its relevant tests, typecheck, and build. Skill\n  synchronization alone proves only that the copy matches this source.\n\nDeletion uses `DELETE /api/users/:userId` with `{ \"confirm\": true }` and `user/delete` authorization. Obtain an explicit user deletion request before calling it. Application role scopes can guard deletion and clean dependent credentials transactionally. Hub blocks self-deletion, deleting its last active administrator, and deleting owners of Apps. Historical user identities are retained but cannot sign in or appear in management lists.\n"}],"isError":false,"timestamp":1790722301456}}

Routes check the `user` record type with one of `read`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `assign-role`, `reset-password`, `revoke-sessions` or `delete`. Account creation checks both `create` and `assign-role`. `delete` is permitted only while an application role scope can clean a deleted user up.\n\n## Register and place the page\n\n1. Register Authentication, Authorization, and then Users in the App's Client\n   and Server plugin arrays.\n2. Configure the Client factory. `users({ mount: 'settings', path: '/users' })`\n   produces `/settings/users`; `mount: 'app'` makes the path App-relative and\n   registers a primary-navigation entry protected by the same page access rule.\n3. Grant the page, `{ resource: { type: 'page', id: 'users' }, actions: [{ action: 'access' }] }` or `authz.pages.grant('users')`, to roles that may open it.\n4. Grant only the `user` actions those roles need, on `{ type: 'user', id: '*' }` because `user` is a record type. The plugin creates no roles and grants no access by itself.\n5. Use `componentLoader` only to replace the page implementation. It does not\n   change the route identity, mount, or path.\n\nThe page reports results through `useToaster()` from `@nocobase/app-client`, so the App needs the `@nocobase/app-client` that exports it and registers a toaster service, as the templates do: `client/lib/toaster.ts` from the template, and `this.app.container.instance(toasterToken, createToaster())` in the `register()` of `client/service-provider.ts`, with the `Toaster` component mounted in `client/react-providers.ts`. Without the registration nothing throws, but its toasts are only logged to the browser console. Update `@nocobase/app-client` together with this plugin; the `nocobase-app-upgrade` Skill's `references/edge-cases.md` (\"Notifications and the application toaster\") has the full steps.\n\nThe default `app` permission-set scope is supplied by Users whenever the Authorization plugin's `authorizationToken` is available. Do not copy a user-roles Provider into an application. Set `users.permissionSets: false` to replace the default with an application-owned scope; Hub uses this setting.\n\n## Add an application role scope\n\nResolve

{"type":"message_start","message":{"role":"toolResult","toolCallId":"call_00_Y6MBvoN1nhnhHasVlNjJ4408","toolName":"bash","content":[{"type":"text","text":"---\nname: nocobase-app-plugin-file\ndescription: Add file collections, uploads, downloads, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX previews, business attachments, and editable Registry file components to a NocoBase 3 App using the public File Repository services.\n---\n\n# Add files to an App\n\nUse `@nocobase/app-plugin-file/server` and `@nocobase/app-plugin-file/client`. The plugin provides Repository managers, service tokens, route helpers, and the component-ui Registry recipe. The App or business plugin owns collections, migrations, Drive configuration, resource routes, permissions, and pages.\n\nInspect the App's existing registrations, migrations, disks, and resources first. Register the Server default export and the Client default factory before consumers, using the App's plugin lifecycle commands. The core does not create collections or routes.\n\n## Find and reuse the preview UI first\n\nInspect `client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/` before writing upload or preview components. Current Default templates preinstall this application-owned Registry source and its client dependencies; older applications and other templates may not. Import from its `index.ts`, not from plugin-internal paths. Registering the plugin supplies services and translations; it does not automatically install or upgrade the copied UI.\n\n| Format                                               | Registry preview                  | Content access                                                                 |\n| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |\n| DOCX / XLSX / PPTX                                   | Local `@silurus/ooxml` viewer     | Same-origin session credentials; no public URL or third-party service required |\n| Raster image / PDF / text / Markdown / audio / video | Built-in preview components       | See the content access rules below                                             |\n| Legacy DOC / XLS / PPT and OpenDocument              | Office Online fallback            | Internet-accessible absolute URL; cannot use the App session                   |\n| Unsupported or unsafe active content                 | Explanation and optional download | Download still requires permission                                             |\n\nFor custom attachment lists, uploads or business associations, reuse `FilePreviewDialog` with file records and `contentUrl`; it requires no repository prop. Extend the existing UI or add the necessary content adapter rather than reimplementing format detection and dropping supported formats. A DOCX download fallback indicates a request/rendering failure or an outdated/custom component, not that the plugin lacks DOCX support. Report the actual failure and preserve its evidence.\n\nIf the installed package, synchronized Skill and copied UI disagree, inspect the resolved plugin version, run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` to refresh guidance, and reconcile the UI source separately. Skills synchronization does not upgrade Registry copies.\n\n## Work incrementally\n\n- Use standard File Repository routes, the Client File Repository and Registry components for new attachment features. Save associations through the existing business API, whether standard CRUD or custom routes; do not migrate working business routes just to add files.\n- Extend existing services, middleware, response adapters or installed UI components where needed. A necessary compatibility handler should delegate to File Repository; do not rebuild upload, storage and metadata handling with Drive or replace the whole CRUD stack.\n- Inspect the App's registration, collection, disk and business save path together. Reuse what works; do not ask the user to choose an implementation or repeatedly explore source when the documented contract suffices.\n- Verify one small upload → metadata query → content download before building UI. Then wire the returned IDs into the existing save/detail flow. Retain uploaded IDs if the business save fails, and run the affected checks after edits stabilize.\n\nThe following business example uses collection `invoice_files`, resource `invoiceAttachments`, connection `main`, and disk `local`. Adapt these to the App.\n\n## Collection\n\nCreate an App-owned, self-contained migration under `database/main/migrations/` with a unique name matching its filename. Replace `main` with the target connection when needed:\n\n```ts\nimport { defineMigration, type MigrationDefinition } from '@nocobase/db';\n\nconst migration: MigrationDefinition = defineMigration({\n  name: '202609080001_create_invoice_files',\n  async up({ builder }) {\n    await builder.createCollection('invoice_files', (collection) => {\n      collection.uuid('id').primary().notNull();\n      collection.string('disk', { length: 255 }).notNull();\n      collection.text('key').notNull();\n      collection.text('filename').notNull();\n      collection.string('ext', { length: 32 }).notNull();\n      collection.string('mimeType', { length: 255 }).notNull();\n      collection.bigInt('size').notNull();\n      collection.datetime('createdAt').notNull();\n      collection.datetime('updatedAt').notNull();\n    });\n  },\n  async down({ builder }) {\n    await builder.dropCollection('invoice_files');\n  },\n});\nexport default migration;\n```\n\nThe fields are fixed; mapping is unsupported. The primary key must accept a 36-character UUID, string fields accept string/char/text, size accepts integer/bigInt, and timestamps accept datetime/datetimeTz. Apply with the App's migration command. Never import a live collection schema from a migration.\n\nUpload generates the ID and storage key, normalizes the filename/extension, validates stored size, and supplies timestamps. Extra required columns need defaults because upload accepts no business values. `contentUrl` is derived, never persisted. Save returned file IDs through an App-owned relation or link table when submitting the business form; upload and form submission are separate commits.\n\n## API routes\n\nDeclare in the App or business plugin's Server routes module and merge both returned contributions into its existing routes:\n\n```ts\nimport { defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-file/server';\n\nconst fileRoutes: ReturnType<typeof defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes> =\n  defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes({\n    repositories: [\n      {\n        name: 'invoiceAttachments',\n        collection: 'invoice_files',\n        connection: 'main',\n        disk: 'local',\n        accessPath: '/uploads/invoices',\n        accessMode: 'stream',\n        policy: {\n          read: {\n            scope: true,\n            fields: [\n              'id',\n              'filename',\n              'ext',\n              'mimeType',\n              'size',\n              'createdAt',\n              'updatedAt',\n            ],\n          },\n          create: { scope: true },\n          update: false,\n          delete: { scope: true },\n        },\n        actions: {\n          findMany: { maxLimit: 100 },\n          findOne: {},\n          deleteOne: {},\n          uploadOne: { maxSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024 },\n          uploadMany: { maxSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 },\n        },\n      },\n    ],\n  });\nexport default fileRoutes;\n```\n\n`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.\n\nOnly declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.\n\n`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.\n\nThese are public routes. E59 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/repository.js:25–49

uploadPolicy：上传继承 exposure 的 create scope/defaults，create:false 保持为 false，字段白名单替换为 FILE_COLUMNS；注释声明“唯一放宽 Policy 之处”。

 * input: which rows this principal may produce (`scope`), and what the server
 * stamps onto them (`defaults`). A `create` that is `false` stays `false`, so
 * an exposure that forbids creating rows forbids uploading them too.
 *
 * This is the only place a Policy is widened, and the reason is specific to
 * this path. It licenses nothing elsewhere.
 */
export function uploadPolicy(base) {
    const create = base.create === true || base.create === false
        ? base.create
        : {
            scope: base.create.scope,
            defaults: base.create.defaults,
            fields: FILE_COLUMNS,
            relations: {},
        };
    // `read` serves this path's own returning record and the public byte route,
    // both of which need every column. `update` and `delete` never run here.
    return {
        create,
        read: { scope: true, fields: FILE_COLUMNS, relations: {} },
        update: false,
        delete: false,
    };
}

原文件 SHA-256：3e3a1d1f33208ae8e7038c8afa89149195897db3679edbad860a379e80ce8fb1

E60 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:116–127

File Skill：accessPath 规则、upload 绑定派生 Policy、内容路由是 Policy 之外的公开例外，并要求受限文件在 `/<name>:<action>` 与 `<accessPath>/*` 上自行注册鉴权。

`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

原文件 SHA-256：06b464d71554a3ae12819918f98a84f44c65c2b70e7fbfcffd17e992e57aed22

E61 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:231–238

File Skill 预览章节：DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 用本地 @silurus/ooxml，同源凭据方可服务受限预览，Bearer-only 需应用适配受信内容端点。

### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

file-preview 库：拒绝 SVG/主动内容的安全图片判定，以及 ooxml 格式解析（排除主动 MIME/扩展）。

export function isSafeImagePreview(file: FileRecord): boolean {
  const mimeType = file.mimeType.split(';', 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
  return (
    mimeType.startsWith('image/') &&
    mimeType !== 'image/svg+xml' &&
    !ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS.has(fileExtension(file.filename))
  );
}

export function resolveOfficeOpenXmlFormat(
  file: FileRecord,
): OfficeOpenXmlFormat | undefined {
  const mimeType = file.mimeType.split(';', 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
  const extension = fileExtension(file.filename);
  if (
    ACTIVE_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType) ||
    mimeType.endsWith('+xml') ||
    ACTIVE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ||
    OFFICE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const extensionFormat = OFFICE_OPEN_XML_EXTENSIONS[extension];
  if (extensionFormat) return extensionFormat;
  return OFFICE_OPEN_XML_MIME_TYPES[mimeType];
}

                    code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
                    message: 'Authentication required',
                }, 401);
            }
            context.set('auth', auth);
            await next();

## Public routes

A webhook or OAuth callback cannot present a session cookie and is public by
design. Public still needs a boundary: verify the provider's signature, bind a
one-time value such as `state` to the request, and rate-limit the endpoint.
Mount it with the application's root routes rather than under `/api`, and do
not put `auth.optional()` on it as if that were protection.

export const orderAdminRoutes: AppApiRouteContribution<Application> =
  defineApiRoutes((app) => {

export class DefaultRepository {
    options;
    /**
     * Normalized scopes, resolved once per instance. A bound Policy is frozen,
     * so its scope cannot change while this Repository lives, and normalizing
     * it on every call meant walking the Collection metadata on every write.
     */
    scopeChecks = new Map();
    constructor(options) {
        this.options = options;
    }
    withPolicy(policy, principal) {
        // A Repository handed out by a policy-bound Connection is still a
        // DefaultRepository, and the Connection types it as `Repository`, so this
        // method stays reachable. Replacing the binding there would hand back an
        // unrestricted Repository and undo the Connection's authorization, so
        // rebinding is refused rather than allowed to widen. Tightening further
        // is what `narrow` is for.
        if (this.options.policy) {
            invalid('INVALID_POLICY', 'This Repository already has a bound Policy. Use narrow() to tighten it; a Policy cannot be replaced.', { collection: this.options.collection });
        }
        const input = typeof policy === 'function' ? policy(principal) : policy;
        return new DefaultRepository({
            ...this.options,
            policy: normalizeRepositoryPolicy(input),
        });
    }

E71 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:238–248

db Skill：filter/values/select/sort 接受 builder 回调或等价 JSON AST，明确不接受简写字符串数组；Repository 自身不应用权限，需在进入 filter 前决定可见性。

`filter`, `values`, `select` and `sort` each accept a builder callback or the equivalent serializable JSON AST, and mean the same thing either way. They do not accept a shorthand string array such as `['id', 'name']` or `['-createdAt']`. Field names are Collection logical names, never column names. A write returns a result object — the record is `result.record`, alongside `result.version` and the created relation targets — rather than the record itself. `findMany` is awaited for an array or iterated asynchronously to consume a large result incrementally.

The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.

E73 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/page.md:126–146

前端页面参考：auth 取值 required/guest/optional，且明确 `auth` 只约束浏览器导航、不是服务端安全；authz 为 resource/action 或 skip/unrestricted。

## 3. auth: who can open the page

| Value      | Use for                                                                                              |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `required` | Only signed-in users can open it. A root route without `auth` gets this                              |
| `guest`    | Sign-in, registration, password reset. Signed-in users who visit are sent away                       |
| `optional` | Opens whether or not the user is signed in; the page adjusts its content to the sign-in state itself |

- Child routes inherit the entry route's `auth` and cannot change it (a different value raises an error at registration).
- Settings pages and dev pages always require sign-in; do not write `auth` on them.
- A signed-out user who visits a `required` page is taken to the sign-in page.
- **`auth` only governs navigation in the browser; it is not server security**. The endpoints the page calls must do their own authentication.

## 4. authz: page authorization

`authz` is a `{ resource: { type, id }, action }` request, `'skip'`, or `'unrestricted'`. Nothing is inferred from the route name. Menus, page loading and the permission set page all read the resolved value, which comes from the root down:

- **A page that declares `authz`** uses it. A malformed value raises an error at registration.
- **A nested page that omits it** inherits the value of its nearest ancestor page, through navigation groups and any number of levels. A child that declares its own value overrides it for itself and its descendants.
- **The first page on a path that omits it** still registers, and the application still starts, with a development warning naming the route, its path and the default applied. A protected App page (`auth: 'required'`) or a settings page becomes `'unrestricted'`: only identities with unrestricted access, such as root, may open it, and it is hidden from everyone else's menus. A `guest` or `optional` App page, or a dev page, becomes `'skip'`.

  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();

  const root = new Hono();
  root.route('/', router);
  return root;
});

E75 · app/server/routes/material-content.ts:32–79

应用自建受保护字节路由：auth.required + ownerId 过滤 + ext 白名单 + nosniff/CSP sandbox/attachment，404 统一隐藏是否存在。

export default defineRootRoutes((app: Application) => {
  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
  const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);

  router.get('/uploads/materials/:file', auth.required(), async (context) => {
    const session = context.get('auth');
    if (!session) return context.json({ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);

    const match = UUID.exec(context.req.param('file'));
    if (!match) return context.notFound();

    const [, id, extension = ''] = match;
    if (!(extension in MIME_TYPES)) return context.notFound();

    const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
    const record = await database
      .repository<MaterialAttachmentRecord>('materialAttachments')
      .findOne({ filter: { id, ownerId: session.user.id } });
    if (!record || record.ext !== extension) return context.notFound();

    const disk = app.container.resolve(driveManagerToken).use(record.disk);
    if (!(await disk.exists(record.key))) return context.notFound();

    const filename = encodeURIComponent(
      Buffer.from(record.filename).toString('utf8'),
    ).replace(
      /['()*]/g,
      (char) => `%${char.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`,
    );

    context.header('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
    context.header('Content-Type', MIME_TYPES[extension]);
    context.header('Content-Length', String(record.size));
    context.header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
    context.header('Content-Security-Policy', "sandbox; default-src 'none'");
    context.header(
      'Content-Disposition',
      `attachment; filename*=UTF-8''${filename}`,
    );
    return context.body(Readable.toWeb(await disk.getStream(record.key)));
  });

  // `defineRootRoutes` returns a plain `Hono`; mounting the typed router keeps `AuthEnv` on the
  // handler while the contribution's factory keeps the shape the runtime expects.
  const root = new Hono();
  root.route('/', router);
  return root;
});

  public async listOwned(ownerId: string): Promise<MaterialWithAttachments[]> {
    const materials = await this.materials.findMany({
      filter: { ownerId },
      sort: (sort) => sort.field('createdAt').desc(),
    });
    if (!materials.length) return [];

    const materialIds = new Set(materials.map((material) => material.id));
    const attachments = await this.attachments.findMany({
      filter: { ownerId },
      sort: (sort) => sort.field('createdAt').asc(),
    });
    const byMaterial = new Map<number, MaterialAttachmentRecord[]>();
    for (const attachment of attachments) {
      if (attachment.materialId === null) continue;
      if (!materialIds.has(attachment.materialId)) continue;
      const bucket = byMaterial.get(attachment.materialId) ?? [];
      bucket.push(attachment);
      byMaterial.set(attachment.materialId, bucket);
    }

    return materials.map((material) => ({
      ...material,
      attachments: byMaterial.get(material.id) ?? [],
    }));
  }

  public async getOwned(
    ownerId: string,
    id: number,
  ): Promise<MaterialWithAttachments | undefined> {
    const material = await this.materials.findOne({
      filter: { id, ownerId },
    });
    if (!material) return undefined;

    const attachments = await this.attachments.findMany({
      filter: { ownerId, materialId: id },
      sort: (sort) => sort.field('createdAt').asc(),
    });
    return { ...material, attachments };
  }

  /** An attachment the caller may link: it exists, belongs to them, and is one of the accepted types. */
  private async resolveAttachmentIds(
    ownerId: string,
    attachmentIds: readonly string[],
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    const unique = [...new Set(attachmentIds.filter(Boolean))];
    if (!unique.length) return [];

    const found = await this.attachments.findMany({
      filter: (filter) =>
        filter.and([
          filter.string('ownerId').eq(ownerId),
          filter.or(unique.map((id) => filter.string('id').eq(id))),
        ]),
    });
    if (found.length !== unique.length) {
      throw new MaterialsError(
        'ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND',
        'One of the selected attachments is missing or belongs to someone else.',
      );
    }
    for (const attachment of found) {
      if (!MATERIAL_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.includes(attachment.ext)) {
        throw new MaterialsError(
          'ATTACHMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED',
          `Only ${MATERIAL_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS.join(', ')} attachments are allowed.`,
        );
      }
    }
    return unique;
  }

应用在 Registry 源上的扩展：ImagePreview 捕获 onError 显示损坏提示与下载，而非静默占位。

}

/**
 * An image attachment, with a failure state that explains a corrupt file instead of silently showing a broken tile.
 *
 * A PNG can upload successfully and still not decode — a truncated or garbage file. The failure belongs to the content,
 * not the request, so it cannot come through `error`; only the browser knows when the bytes load. This component tracks
 * that and, on failure, says the file is damaged and offers the download, which is the one action still worth taking.
 */
function ImagePreview(inputProps: {
  readonly file: FileRecord;
  readonly url?: string;
  readonly onDownload?: () => void;
}): ReactElement {
  const { t } = useTranslation('@nocobase/app-plugin-file');
  const { file, url, onDownload } = inputProps;
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  if (failed) {
    return (
      <div
        role='alert'
        className='flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center'
      >
        <ImageOff
          aria-hidden='true'
          className='size-10 text-muted-foreground'
        />
        <p className='font-medium'>{t('files.imageFailed')}</p>
        <p className='max-w-md text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          {t('files.imageFailedDescription')}
        </p>
        {onDownload ? (
          <Button type='button' onClick={onDownload}>
            {t('files.downloadFile', { defaultValue: 'Download file' })}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <img
      src={url}
      alt={file.filename}
      className='max-h-[70vh] max-w-full object-contain'
      onError={() => setFailed(true)}
    />
  );
}
